notes: GLiNER2.5 Multi (litert-community/GLiNER2.5-Multi-LiteRT, Hub revision 3bcde0b8848de935aa33f94b1e81a0c9b58a843c, published 2026-10-02; source fastino/gliner2.5-multi-v1 rev 235cf92d, Apache-2.0, mDeBERTa-v3-base BoundaryExtractor: 12 layers, hidden 768, vocabulary 250,112). Schema-based entity extraction with the fixed ordered labels person / organization / location / product / date, threshold 0.5; English with the official whitespace splitter, Japanese with the official char splitter (caller-selected). Graph = dense prefix (encoder, boundary encoder, boundary query head, per-token projections); inputs inputs_embeds [1,256,768] (host float16-table lookup, rows upcast to float32), attention_mask [1,256], text_routing [1,192,256], query_routing [1,5,256], text_mask [1,192]; one packed float32 output [1,1,1,292958] (17 logical slices) that the host's upstream sparse decoder turns into spans. wfp16 storage: the 96 FULLY_CONNECTED weights float16 + DEQUANTIZE, everything else float32 (1149 operators). The shipped graphs carry two fp32-exact rewrites (attention-mask fill -1e4; every LayerNorm on x*2^-3 with eps*2^-6, bit-identical to the stock graph in fp32, 60/60 comparisons) so fp16 computation is finite; GpuOptions(precision = FP32) is the validated GPU setting. artifact_sha256 = the Hub LFS sha256 (API siblings.lfs, read 2026-10-02), equal to the local file's sha256 verified after upload. Reference for parity = the official gliner2 2.0.0 fp32 CPU implementation on the lane's 80 bilingual fixtures (35 English, 45 Japanese; 70/75/80 fit windows 128/256/512). Lane record: ~/code/standup/handoffs/2026-10-02-gliner25-multi-resume.md; run dir /Users/USER/code/codex-conversions/2026-09-19/gliner25-multi. The fp32 graphs (fp32/) and the fp32 host table are reference downloads, not catalog rows; the GPU FP32 run of the s128 fp32 graph (70/70, max |dconfidence| 3.2e-4, median 24.3 ms) is in the lane's device files.
